assignments.name: meeting_briefing

parameters.content:
## Proposed Workflow Design

This workflow automates Calendly booking intake into HubSpot and prepares the meeting owner with useful context before the call.

The workflow first parses and validates the Calendly booking email. Valid bookings create or update the HubSpot contact and optionally add booking notes to the CRM.

Business-email leads continue into company enrichment. The workflow checks a Google Sheets cache first to avoid duplicate research. If no cache exists, an AI Agent uses web search and structured output parsing to collect company information, then saves the result back to the cache.

Personal or private email bookings skip company enrichment. These bookings are logged in Google Sheets and trigger a lightweight notification so they can be reviewed manually if needed.

Successful enrichment is used to calculate an ICP score, which is saved back to HubSpot. The workflow then sends a meeting briefing by Gmail. Invalid bookings or failed enrichment cases are routed to manual review without breaking the rest of the workflow.

## Valid Prospect Booking?

Checks whether the parsed booking has the required fields to continue.

Valid bookings continue to HubSpot contact creation. Invalid, incomplete, or unusual bookings are routed to manual review.

## Manual Review

Receives bookings that cannot be processed safely.

This branch ends here unless a manual-review alert is added. These records should be reviewed before creating or updating CRM data.

## Workflow Documentation

1. The workflow starts when Gmail receives a Calendly booking notification.

2. The booking email is parsed to extract structured details, including prospect name, email address, lifecycle stage, lead source, booking event ID, meeting start time, company domain, and booking notes.

3. The workflow checks whether the booking is a valid prospect booking.

4. If the booking is invalid, incomplete, or unusual, it is routed to manual review and does not continue into the automated CRM and enrichment path.

5. If the booking is valid, the workflow creates or updates the HubSpot contact using the prospect email address.

6. The workflow prepares booking-note data for HubSpot.

7. If booking notes are present, the workflow creates a HubSpot note associated with the contact. If no notes are present, this step is skipped.

8. The workflow checks whether the prospect used a business email address.

9. If the prospect used a personal or private email address, company enrichment is skipped. The booking is logged in Google Sheets and a notification email is sent for manual awareness.

10. If the prospect used a business email address, the workflow processes the booking through the enrichment path one company at a time to reduce rate-limit risk.

11. The workflow checks the Google Sheets enrichment cache using the company domain.

12. If cached enrichment exists, the workflow reuses the cached company profile.

13. If no cached enrichment exists, the workflow waits briefly, then uses an AI Agent with a chat model, SerpAPI web search, and a structured output parser to research the company.

14. The AI enrichment result is normalized into the workflow’s standard company-enrichment format.

15. Newly researched enrichment data is saved back to the Google Sheets cache so future bookings from the same company can reuse it.

16. The workflow checks whether enrichment was successful.

17. If enrichment fails or no reliable company data is found, the booking is routed to manual review and the workflow continues processing the next company.

18. If enrichment succeeds, the workflow calculates the prospect’s ICP score using company signals such as industry, employee count, geography, enterprise sales motion, funding stage, technologies, and confidence.

19. The calculated ICP score is saved back to the HubSpot contact.

20. The workflow builds a meeting briefing using the contact, booking details, enrichment results, source URLs, and ICP score.

21. The meeting briefing is sent by Gmail so the meeting owner has useful context before speaking with the prospect.

22. After each business-email booking is processed, the loop moves to the next booking until all items are complete.

=You are a B2B company enrichment assistant.

Research the company connected to this domain:
{{ $('Parse Calendly Booking').item.json.company_domain }}

Prospect email:
{{ $('Parse Calendly Booking').item.json.email }}
Use the available web search tool when needed to identify the company and extract reliable public information.

Rules:
- Do not guess.
- Use only credible public sources.
- If a field is unknown, return null.
- If the company cannot be confidently identified, set enrichment_status to "not_found".
- Return only the required structured JSON format.
- Include source URLs used for the enrichment.
- For technologies and source_urls, always return an array. If unknown or unavailable, return [].
- Never return null for technologies or source_urls.
Your final response must contain exactly one top-level field called output. Put all enrichment fields inside output. Do not return enrichment fields at the top level.

parameters.content:
## Parse Calendly Booking

Extracts structured booking data from the Calendly email.

Outputs prospect name, email, email domain, company domain, meeting title, meeting start time, booking event ID, booking notes, source, and validation fields.

## Upsert HubSpot Contact

Creates or updates the HubSpot contact using the prospect email.

The resulting HubSpot contact ID is reused later for notes, ICP scoring, and meeting briefing context.

## Upsert HubSpot Contact

Creates or updates the HubSpot contact using the prospect email.

The resulting HubSpot contact ID is reused later for notes, ICP scoring, and meeting briefing context.

## Booking Notes Present?

Checks whether the Calendly booking includes notes.

If notes are present, the workflow creates a HubSpot note. If notes are empty, note creation is skipped.

## Business Email?

Determines whether the prospect used a business email address.

Business emails continue to company enrichment. Personal or private email domains skip enrichment and are logged separately.

## Create HubSpot Booking Note

Creates a HubSpot note associated with the contact.

The note stores booking context such as prospect intent, requested topics, and additional Calendly form details.

## Format Private Email Booking

Formats private-email bookings for logging.

Company enrichment and ICP scoring are skipped because the email domain does not reliably identify a company.

## Append Private Email Booking

Adds the private-email booking to the Google Sheets tracking tab.

This creates a lightweight review queue for personal-email bookings without interrupting the main CRM intake workflow.

## Send Private Email Alert

Notifies the workflow owner when a private-email booking is logged.

This alert is useful because private-email bookings are rare and may need manual qualification.

## Process One Company At A Time

Processes business-email bookings sequentially.

This reduces rate-limit risk for Google Sheets, SerpAPI, OpenAI, and other enrichment-related services.

## Lookup Enrichment Cache

Searches the Google Sheets enrichment cache using the company domain.

If a matching company profile already exists, the workflow reuses cached enrichment instead of running AI web research again.

## Use Cached Enrichment

Normalizes cached Google Sheets data back into the same structure used by AI enrichment.

This keeps downstream ICP scoring and briefing nodes consistent across cached and newly enriched leads.

## Cache Found?

Checks whether the cache lookup returned usable enrichment data.

Cached records continue directly to ICP scoring. Missing cache records continue to the AI enrichment branch.

## Wait Before Company Research

Adds a short delay before AI web enrichment.

This helps reduce rate-limit pressure when multiple business-email bookings are processed close together.

## Research Leads

Uses an AI Agent to research the company behind the prospect’s business email domain. The agent uses a chat model, web search, and structured output parsing to return standardized enrichment fields.

## OpenAI Chat Model

Provides the language model used by the AI Agent. Use a low temperature for more consistent company research and structured output.

## Search Company Research

Provides web search access for the AI Agent. The agent uses this tool to look up public company information such as website, industry, employee range, geography, and source URLs.

## Company Enrichment Output Parser

Forces AI enrichment into a predictable JSON structure. This protects downstream nodes from inconsistent AI responses and makes ICP scoring easier to maintain.

## Normalize AI Enrichment

Converts the AI Agent output into the workflow’s standard enrichment format.

Adds contact ID, company domain, enrichment status, source, confidence, company profile fields, technologies, and source URLs.

## Save Enrichment Cache

Appends newly researched company enrichment data to Google Sheets.

Future bookings from the same company domain can reuse this cached profile, reducing cost, latency, and rate-limit risk.

## Enrichment Found?

Checks whether enrichment succeeded.

Successful enrichment continues to ICP scoring. Failed or low-confidence enrichment routes to manual review instead of breaking the workflow.

## Restore Enrichment After Cache Save

Restores the normalized enrichment payload after the Google Sheets append step.

This is needed because the Sheets node may output row data instead of the enrichment object expected by downstream nodes.

## Manual Review: Enrichment Failed

Handles business-email bookings where enrichment failed or no reliable company match was found.

This branch connects back to the loop so the next booking can continue processing.

## Calculate ICP Score

Calculates the lead’s ICP fit score from enrichment data.

Signals can include industry, employee count, geography, enterprise sales motion, funding stage, technologies, and confidence.

## Update Contact ICP

Writes the calculated ICP score back to the HubSpot contact.

This keeps qualification data available directly in the CRM.

## Build Meeting Briefing

Builds the final briefing from booking data, HubSpot contact data, enrichment results, source URLs, and ICP score.

The briefing helps the meeting owner prepare before speaking with the prospect.

## Send Meeting Briefing

Sends the meeting briefing by Gmail.

This is the final successful output for enriched or cached business-email bookings.
